uncertain: Not a forest plot and not vector: the figure (Extended Data Fig. 2, 'Mx agent auto-evaluation') is one embedded 3661x2460 RGB raster on page 15 holding a 3x5 grid of line charts; every value is read from pixels of that bitmap (line centre +-2 px = +-0.004 in row 1, +-0.001 in rows 2-3 axis units)
Each line has 6 vertices at log2-equal spacing from 32k to 1M prompt tokens; only 64k/256k/1M carry tick labels, the 32k/128k/512k x values are inferred from the gridline spacing
Rows 2-3 draw no horizontal gridlines: their y maps are fitted to the tick-label glyph centres (calibrated on row 1, where glyph centre = gridline + 1 px); row 3 is labelled 0.9 and 0.8 only

Rows with confidence 0.6 are lines hidden under a series drawn later (legend order green < blue < red): the value is the visible line's, the true one lies within one line width (~0.02 row 1, ~0.004 rows 2-3)
err_lo/err_hi are the shaded 95% CI band edges read from the tint mask (+-3 px); 'confidence_err' (extra field) is 0.5 where the band is barely wider than the line, i.e. row-1 CIs smaller than ~0.01

Stars ('using reference guidelines (oracle)') are plotted ~25 px right of the 64k gridline and have no x; value = star centroid. r3c1 blue star is crossed by the red line (core centroid); r3c3 shows no green star and r2c5 no blue dotted line (probably coincident with the red dotted line at 0.819)
Dotted 'no retrieval' lines are horizontal constants (x = null); row 1 has none
bbox_px tiles the crop between neighbouring frames (titles above, tick labels left/bottom); the axes frame itself is given in each panel's first note
band edges (err_lo/err_hi) carry their own confidence of [0.5, 0.75] (removed from rows for schema compliance; lower than the line values): 259 rows
